Oxid has a dark sewer type of theme, with small rooms and passages. It has 2 yellow armors and 1 red, which makes the map harder to control. The textures are originally quite dark, and there has been a new set of textures made, which gives the map a clearer and brighter look, the new texture set can be found at https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/540/oxid-texture-set/

Location file is made by {{player|flintheart|flag=se}}
